editorial.evidence: Built a 104-row inventory from the 62 captured sections (27 Interview Guide parts, 35 Answer Template sections, intro), splitting rich sections such as the sizing, gate and weights parts into separate mechanism rows. The guide and template repeat the ladder, architecture, failures, MVP and 60-minute plan; these are merged into one walkthrough step each, with every template-only detail (Kubernetes/serverless example, 0.43/0.75 threshold, max retries 2, six audit questions, contradictory-memory and infinite-retry rows, 1,000-case variant) kept and named. I rechecked all sizing products and worked the sample-size formula at p = 0.8 into the text. Source gaps handled: the fast-learning trade-off had only a figure, explained as the demotion net; the prompt-optimisation section's admitted lack of optimiser sources is kept. First-person interview phrasing outside spoken examples was recast. The brief opens on the ops agent and the unreviewed-regression constraint, defines skill, rung, gate, shadow and stratum, and gives a short Orion trace before the task, since the five-rung vocabulary is otherwise unfamiliar. Source inconsistencies resolved in text (2026-11-16): 'five controls' with four named → five listed, the fifth (permission changes always need a human) taken from the guide's own autonomy table; Orion diagrams one step off their text → placed beside the steps they depict and the reader-facing note about the misplacement removed. November 21 complete maintained-baseline review: All five sections of self-adapting-agent: brief, sixteen walkthrough steps with figures and tables, registry, gate checks, latency, cost, governance, trade-offs and references deep dives, every practice reveal and the Quick review. Historical captured-source mappings remain preserved; this pass audits the maintained baseline.
